summary: An excellent opportunity to acquire a spacious three-bedroom maisonette, currently utilised as a four-bedroom property, occupying a particularly convenient position within the highly sought-after Gosforth area of Newcastle upon Tyne.
description:
Offering generous and versatile accommodation arranged over two floors, the property would ideally suit a range of buyers and could also appeal to investors looking for a property with excellent letting potential. The property is accessed via its own entrance door, with stairs rising to the first floor. The accommodation at this level comprises a welcoming landing, spacious lounge, second reception room currently utilised as a bedroom, a further bedroom, kitchen and family bathroom. To the second floor are two further bedrooms and a separate shower room, providing excellent flexibility for modern family living, sharers, home working or those requiring additional sleeping accommodation. The property offers particularly versatile living arrangements, with the current layout providing four bedrooms in total despite being originally arranged as a three-bedroom maisonette. This flexibility makes the property suitable for a variety of purchasers and offers scope for the accommodation to be adapted according to individual requirements. The location is a major feature of this property. Gosforth is one of Newcastle upon Tyne's most popular and well-established residential suburbs, offering an excellent balance between suburban living and convenient access to Newcastle city centre. The area is renowned for its leafy streets, established residential neighbourhoods, good choice of schools and excellent selection of shops, cafés, restaurants and everyday amenities. Station Road itself is particularly well placed for local amenities, with Gosforth High Street and Gosforth Central providing a wide range of shops, supermarkets, cafés, restaurants and other services. There are also a number of independent businesses within the area, giving Gosforth a vibrant and well-established community feel. The area is also particularly attractive for families, with a good selection of schools and educational facilities within the wider Gosforth area. Excellent transport links further enhance the location. Gosforth is served by the Tyne and Wear Metro, which is just a short walk from the property itself with South Gosforth and Regent Centre stations providing convenient connections into Newcastle city centre and across the wider region. Frequent bus services also operate through the area, while the A1 and Great North Road provide good road connections for those travelling by car. For those who enjoy outdoor recreation, Gosforth offers a number of attractive green spaces, including Gosforth Central Park, whilst the wider area benefits from its proximity to the Town Moor and Jesmond Dene. These facilities provide excellent opportunities for walking, leisure and outdoor activities. The property is offered for sale with NO ONWARD CHAIN, and viewings are available immediately. Early viewing is strongly recommended to appreciate the size, flexibility and excellent location this property has to offer.

ENTRANCE HALL The entrance is accessed via a private entrance door, with stairs rising to the first floor and providing access to the main accommodation.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING

The first-floor landing provides access to the lounge and the bedrooms, creating a practical central area from which the main accommodation is accessed.

LOUNGE

The spacious lounge provides a comfortable and versatile living area, featuring a UPVC-framed double-glazed window which allows plenty of natural light into the room. There is attractive wood flooring, with ample space for a range of lounge furniture together with a dining table and chairs, making this an ideal space for both relaxing and entertaining. A door leads through to the kitchen, providing convenient access between the principal living areas.

SECOND RECEPTION ROOM The spacious second reception room is currently utilised as a bedroom and benefits from a UPVC-framed double-glazed window and radiator.

KITCHEN The kitchen has been newly appointed with a range of modern white high-gloss base and wall-mounted units, complemented by laminated work surfaces. There is an inset sink unit with drainer and mixer tap, together with integrated oven, hob and extractor. Further provision is made for an automatic washing machine and dishwasher, with space also available for a fridge freezer. The kitchen benefits from a radiator, UPVC-framed double-glazed window and a wall-mounted gas combination central heating boiler. A door leads through to the inner hall, providing access to the remainder of the accommodation.

INNER HALL The inner hall provides access to the bathroom and features stairs leading down to the rear of the property, where there is an external courtyard. The layout provides convenient access to both the internal accommodation and the outside space.

FAMILY BATHROOM The family bathroom is fitted with a white suite comprising a panelled bath with inset electric shower over, wash hand basin and WC. The room features tiled walls and flooring, together with a radiator and UPVC-framed double-glazed window, providing natural light and ventilation.

INNER HALL The inner hall also provides access to stairs rising to the second floor, leading to the additional bedroom accommodation and shower room.

SECOND FLOOR LANDING The second-floor landing features an attractive exposed brick wall, creating a characterful focal point, together with a skylight which allows natural light to flood into the landing area. The landing provides access to the additional bedrooms and shower room.

BEDROOM TWO Bedroom Two is a well-proportioned double bedroom offering ample space for a range of bedroom furniture. The room benefits from a built-in wardrobe, useful storage to the eaves and a skylight which allows plenty of natural light into the room. A radiator provides heating, creating a comfortable and versatile bedroom space.

BEDROOM THREE Bedroom Three is a well-proportioned double bedroom offering ample space for a range of bedroom furniture. The room benefits from a built-in wardrobe, useful storage to the eaves and a skylight which allows plenty of natural light into the room. A radiator provides heating, creating a comfortable and versatile bedroom space.

SHOWER ROOM The shower room is fitted with a modern white suite comprising a shower cubicle with inset electric shower, wash hand basin and WC. The room benefits from tiled walls and flooring, together with a skylight providing an abundance of natural light.

EXTERNALLY Externally, the property benefits from a private rear courtyard, enclosed by gated access, providing a low-maintenance outdoor space.
